title: Batch vs streaming: choose the freshness budget
summary: Theory / ETL / ELT & Pipelines / Processing modes / Latency and correctness

children.text: A dashboard is refreshed daily, but operations wants a five-minute fraud alert. When would you use batch versus streaming?

items: Ask how stale each output is allowed to be.
Separate event time from arrival time.
Compare operating cost, recovery and support capacity.

children.text: Batch processes a bounded collection. Streaming incrementally processes arriving data and needs explicit decisions about late events, state and recovery. Choose a freshness objective and operational model for each consumer; one architecture need not serve every latency requirement.

children.title: Watch for this
children.text: Streaming is not automatically real time or exactly once end-to-end. Source, state and sink behavior all matter.

items: How would a late event update yesterday's aggregate?
Mention correctness and failure handling, not just speed.
